callbacks.name: Awake
callbacks.description: Called once when the script instance is loaded, before Start, even if the component is disabled.

callbacks.name: OnEnable
callbacks.description: Called when the object becomes enabled and active.

callbacks.name: Start
callbacks.description: Called once before the first frame Update, only if the component is enabled.

callbacks.name: FixedUpdate
callbacks.description: Called every fixed framerate frame (Time.fixedDeltaTime). Use for physics.

callbacks.name: Update
callbacks.description: Called every frame while the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

callbacks.name: LateUpdate
callbacks.description: Called every frame after all Update functions (follow cameras, final adjustments).

callbacks.name: OnDisable
callbacks.description: Called when the behaviour becomes disabled or the object is destroyed.

callbacks.name: OnDestroy
callbacks.description: Called when the MonoBehaviour will be destroyed.

callbacks.name: OnValidate
callbacks.description: Editor only: called when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

callbacks.name: Reset
callbacks.description: Editor only: called when the component is first added or Reset is chosen in the Inspector.

callbacks.name: OnApplicationPause
callbacks.description: Called when the application pauses or resumes (mobile background/foreground).

callbacks.name: OnApplicationFocus
callbacks.description: Called when the player window gains or loses focus.

callbacks.name: OnApplicationQuit
callbacks.description: Called on all game objects before the application quits (and when play mode stops in the Editor).

callbacks.name: OnCollisionEnter
callbacks.description: Called when this collider/rigidbody starts touching another rigidbody/collider.

callbacks.name: OnCollisionStay
callbacks.description: Called once per physics frame for every collider/rigidbody that is touching.

callbacks.name: OnCollisionExit
callbacks.description: Called when this collider/rigidbody stops touching another rigidbody/collider.

callbacks.name: OnTriggerEnter
callbacks.description: Called when another collider enters this trigger.

callbacks.name: OnTriggerStay
callbacks.description: Called once per physics frame for every collider inside this trigger.

callbacks.name: OnTriggerExit
callbacks.description: Called when another collider leaves this trigger.

callbacks.name: OnCollisionEnter2D
callbacks.description: 2D physics: called when an incoming collider makes contact.

callbacks.name: OnCollisionStay2D
callbacks.description: 2D physics: called each frame while colliders touch.

callbacks.name: OnCollisionExit2D
callbacks.description: 2D physics: called when colliders stop touching.

callbacks.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
callbacks.description: 2D physics: called when another collider enters this trigger.

callbacks.name: OnTriggerStay2D
callbacks.description: 2D physics: called each frame while another collider is inside this trigger.

callbacks.name: OnTriggerExit2D
callbacks.description: 2D physics: called when another collider leaves this trigger.

callbacks.name: OnControllerColliderHit
callbacks.description: Called when a CharacterController hits a collider while moving.

callbacks.name: OnJointBreak
callbacks.description: Called when a joint attached to the same GameObject breaks.

callbacks.name: OnJointBreak2D
callbacks.description: Called when a Joint2D attached to the same GameObject breaks.

callbacks.name: OnParticleCollision
callbacks.description: Called when a particle hits a collider (Collision module, Send Collision Messages).

callbacks.name: OnParticleTrigger
callbacks.description: Called when particles meet the conditions of the Trigger module.

callbacks.name: OnParticleSystemStopped
callbacks.description: Called when every particle system on this GameObject has stopped (Stop Action = Callback).

callbacks.name: OnMouseDown
callbacks.description: Called when the user presses the mouse button over this collider or GUIElement.

callbacks.name: OnMouseUp
callbacks.description: Called when the user releases the mouse button.

callbacks.name: OnMouseUpAsButton
callbacks.description: Called when the mouse is released over the same collider it was pressed on.

callbacks.name: OnMouseEnter
callbacks.description: Called when the mouse enters this collider.

callbacks.name: OnMouseOver
callbacks.description: Called every frame while the mouse is over this collider.

callbacks.name: OnMouseExit
callbacks.description: Called when the mouse leaves this collider.

callbacks.name: OnMouseDrag
callbacks.description: Called while the user drags after pressing the mouse on this collider.

callbacks.name: OnBecameVisible
callbacks.description: Called when the renderer becomes visible by any camera.

callbacks.name: OnBecameInvisible
callbacks.description: Called when the renderer is no longer visible by any camera.

callbacks.name: OnWillRenderObject
callbacks.description: Called once for each camera if the object is visible and not a UI element.

callbacks.name: OnRenderObject
callbacks.description: Called after a camera renders the scene (use with GL calls).

callbacks.name: OnDrawGizmos
callbacks.description: Draw gizmos that are always visible in the Scene view.

callbacks.name: OnDrawGizmosSelected
callbacks.description: Draw gizmos only when the object is selected.

callbacks.name: OnGUI
callbacks.description: Immediate-mode GUI (IMGUI); called several times per frame.

callbacks.name: OnAnimatorMove
callbacks.description: Callback for processing animation movements (root motion).

callbacks.name: OnAnimatorIK
callbacks.description: Callback for setting up animation IK (inverse kinematics).

callbacks.name: OnTransformParentChanged
callbacks.description: Called when the parent of the transform changes.

callbacks.name: OnTransformChildrenChanged
callbacks.description: Called when the list of children of the transform changes.

callbacks.name: OnRectTransformDimensionsChange
callbacks.description: Called when the dimensions of an associated RectTransform change.

callbacks.name: OnCanvasGroupChanged
callbacks.description: Called when the state of the parent CanvasGroup changes.

callbacks.name: OnPreRender
callbacks.description: Built-in render pipeline only: called before a camera starts rendering.

callbacks.name: OnPostRender
callbacks.description: Built-in render pipeline only: called after a camera finishes rendering.

callbacks.name: OnRenderImage
callbacks.description: Built-in render pipeline only: post-process the rendered image.

callbacks.name: Awake
callbacks.description: Called when the ScriptableObject instance is created or loaded.

callbacks.name: OnEnable
callbacks.description: Called when the object is loaded.

callbacks.name: OnDisable
callbacks.description: Called when the object goes out of scope or is unloaded.

callbacks.name: OnDestroy
callbacks.description: Called when the ScriptableObject will be destroyed.

callbacks.name: OnValidate
callbacks.description: Editor only: called when the asset is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

callbacks.name: Reset
callbacks.description: Editor only: called when the asset is created or Reset is chosen.

callbacks.name: OnEnable
callbacks.description: Called when the custom inspector is shown (cache SerializedProperty fields here).

callbacks.name: OnDisable
callbacks.description: Called when the custom inspector is hidden.

callbacks.name: OnSceneGUI
callbacks.description: Draw handles and react to input in the Scene view for the inspected object.

callbacks.name: CreateGUI
callbacks.description: UI Toolkit: build the window's visual tree (rootVisualElement).

callbacks.name: OnGUI
callbacks.description: IMGUI: draw the window contents.

callbacks.name: OnEnable
callbacks.description: Called when the window is opened or after a domain reload.

callbacks.name: OnDisable
callbacks.description: Called when the window is closed or before a domain reload.

callbacks.name: OnFocus
callbacks.description: Called when the window gets keyboard focus.

callbacks.name: OnLostFocus
callbacks.description: Called when the window loses keyboard focus.

callbacks.name: OnSelectionChange
callbacks.description: Called whenever the selection changes.

callbacks.name: OnHierarchyChange
callbacks.description: Called whenever an object in the hierarchy changes.

callbacks.name: OnProjectChange
callbacks.description: Called whenever the project assets change.

callbacks.name: OnInspectorUpdate
callbacks.description: Called about 10 times per second to repaint.

callbacks.name: Update
callbacks.description: Called many times per second on all visible windows.

callbacks.name: OnDestroy
callbacks.description: Called when the window is closed.

callbacks.name: OnStateEnter
callbacks.signature: override void OnStateEnter(Animator animator, AnimatorStateInfo stateInfo, int layerIndex)
callbacks.description: Called when a transition starts and the state machine starts to evaluate this state.

callbacks.name: OnStateUpdate
callbacks.signature: override void OnStateUpdate(Animator animator, AnimatorStateInfo stateInfo, int layerIndex)
callbacks.description: Called on each Update frame between OnStateEnter and OnStateExit.

callbacks.name: OnStateExit
callbacks.signature: override void OnStateExit(Animator animator, AnimatorStateInfo stateInfo, int layerIndex)
callbacks.description: Called when a transition ends and the state machine finishes evaluating this state.
